spec.tier: GPT-4-class general capability (frozen threshold; historical points approximated via public MMLU-era scores)
spec.fix_rule: volume-weighted median of receipted qualifying runs, with depth requirement (>= K=5 independent buys of >= N=10M tokens each per window) so a loss-leader sip cannot set the fix; this backtest uses documented launch/posted prices as a proxy (see caveats)
spec.caveats: Pre-2025 points are documented launch-announcement prices, not receipted runs. Tier qualification is approximate (no frozen COG-1 basket existed historically). Points marked provisional await a qualifying basket run. The backtest shows the shape the fix would have had; it is labeled approximate throughout.
